name: curved_duct_htc
title: Curved-duct single-phase heat-transfer coefficients (function library)
summary: Seven EES FUNCTIONS returning the single-phase convection coefficient of helically coiled pipes (Ito critical-Re regime switching; laminar Xhan/Zhang, transition Xhan with the Ito friction factor, turbulent Schmidt factor or Di Piazza-Ciofalo), curved rectangular ducts (Facao-Oliveira), straight rectangular ducts (Shah-London polynomial + Gnielinski with linear interpolation) and spiral-plate (SPHE) channels.
